The '''Director Droid DX-10''' was a model of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]], and an upgraded version of the [[Assembly Director Droid DX-9]]. A number of DX-10 droids oversaw the Research and Development section of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
